notes_for_editor: Only a volunteer list names a place, and the list is undated; its newest reference is the 2013 MNR decision. The provincial tower dataset in the local cache (data/raw/ontario_lio/fire_towers.geojson, OFFICIAL_NAME 'Manning', TOW-32533-1, verified, within 10 m) has a point at 48.13883, -83.39861, which matches our record's coordinates. The dataset page itself did not return that content, so it is not cited. Nothing found on construction, staffing, fires, or whether the tower was among the 2013 removals.
